The required research dataset is external and was not availability-checked or downloaded in Stage 3.
Root and case documentation provide different external dataset locations without establishing whether they are byte-identical.

No reusable trained checkpoint or repository-bundled results package is identified.
Accelerated JAX hardware is mentioned, but the original hardware/runtime is not specified.
notes: R1 is retained because the source and detailed use paths are present, but the unversioned environment and external dataset prevent a substantially defined R2 environment/install workflow.
